errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена като „%ВЕИ в общоенергийната системна генерация“.
errors.evidence: The Y-axis does not have a label. The text "%ВЕИ в общоенергийната системна генерация" is the label for the data series, as shown in the legend.

errors.text_span: Линията започва на стойност около 3% през 2000 г.
errors.evidence: The data line does not start in the year 2000. It begins after 2010 (around 2011) at a value of approximately 7%.

errors.text_span: и се покачва постепенно до приблизително 38% през 2050 г.
errors.evidence: The value of the line at the year 2050 is approximately 41% or 42%, not 38%.

errors.text_span: Между 2010 и 2020 г. рязко се увеличава от около 6% до приблизително 16%.
errors.evidence: The data in the 2010-2020 interval does not start at 6% nor end at 16%. It starts around 2011 at ~7% and reaches a value of approximately 18-19% by 2020.
The description uses subjective language ("increases sharply"), which is an interpretation of the trend rather than a neutral description of the data.

errors.text_span: между 2040 и 2050 г. стойността се увеличава от приблизително 32% до 38%.
errors.evidence: The values for the 2040-2050 interval are incorrect. The line increases from approximately 33-34% in 2040 to about 41-42% in 2050, not from 32% to 38%.

errors.text_span: Линията започва на стойност около 0.3 от оста Y през 2000 г. и се покачва постепенно до приблизително 3.8 от оста Y през 2050 г.
errors.evidence: This sentence completely misinterprets the dotted line. It is a logarithmic trendline plotted on the same Y-axis (0-45) as the main data, not on a separate scale from 0.3 to 3.8. Furthermore, the dotted line is only visible for the period roughly between 2011 and 2015; it does not start in 2000 or extend to 2050.
The description fails to mention that the data points on the solid blue line are marked with circles.
